Read the collection ids with db.listCollections() through run_read_query.

answer.message: Agent mode on Firestore reads metadata only: collection ids, a whole collection's document count, and whether a document the request names in full exists and when it was created and last updated. Document ids, paths, field names and field values count as stored values, since they name users and tenants, so none of them is read in agent mode. Documents are never listed in agent mode; count a collection with db.collection("ID").count() through run_read_query.

A collection's fields are sampled from its documents, so agent mode lists each collection with __name__ as its one column.
